proof_route.O1: Squared polynomial bump cutoffs give a quadratic energy bound. Finite mass bootstraps every even moment; domination yields all monomials. Native dominated convergence passes the Stein tests to the recurrence, obtaining factorial moments. Previously proved full-real-line factorial-moment uniqueness identifies the actual measure. Forward direction is actual compact-support integration by parts.
proof_route.O1-kernel: A compact smooth positive-ray function with zero full integral has a proved compact smooth primitive. Subtracting a normalized bump reduces all tests to derivatives; native fundamental-lemma AE equality shows locally integrable zero weak derivative means constant. Apply to tau*p-q. No differentiable density or representative is assumed.
